# pangolin_access_logs (Data Source)

Queries the `access` audit log of the configured organization. Covers per-request access decisions on protected HTTP resources.

> **Note:** Per-entry field shapes vary per Pangolin build and are not statically modeled here. Each entry is surfaced as a raw JSON string in `entries`; use `jsondecode()` to access individual fields. `filter_attributes` is a map whose values are JSON-encoded arrays (one per dimension: `actors`, `resources`, `locations`, `actions`, `protocols`, ...) - which keys are present depends on the log kind.

> Requires an active Pangolin Cloud subscription (or enterprise license on self-host).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Query the access audit log for the last 24 hours.
data "pangolin_access_logs" "recent" {
  time_start = timeadd(timestamp(), "-24h")
  limit      = 100
}

output "access_log_total" {
  value = data.pangolin_access_logs.recent.total
}

# Each entry is a JSON string, jsondecode() to access fields.
output "access_log_first_entry" {
  value = length(data.pangolin_access_logs.recent.entries) > 0 ? jsondecode(data.pangolin_access_logs.recent.entries[0]) : null
}

# filter_attributes is a map of dimension -> JSON-encoded array.
output "access_log_actors_seen" {
  value = jsondecode(lookup(data.pangolin_access_logs.recent.filter_attributes, "actors", "[]"))
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `action` (String) Filter by action value (semantics depend on the log kind).
- `actor` (String) Filter by actor identifier (user, API key, or anonymous).
- `limit` (Number) Maximum number of entries to return. The API enforces its own ceiling.
- `offset` (Number) Skip the first N entries in the result set. Use with `limit` to paginate.
- `resource_id` (String) Filter by the numeric ID of the resource involved in the event.
- `time_end` (String) End of the time range as an ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 timestamp. Defaults to the current time when omitted.
- `time_start` (String) Start of the time range as an ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 timestamp. Defaults to 7 days ago when omitted.

### Read-Only

- `entries` (List of String) Matching entries, each as a JSON-encoded string. Use `jsondecode()` per entry to access fields.
- `filter_attributes` (Map of String) Distinct values seen in the result set for each dimension. Keys vary per log kind; each value is a JSON-encoded array (use `jsondecode()`).
- `total` (Number) Total number of entries matching the filter, ignoring pagination.
